description: Gate policy used by Section 03 Step 14. Edit this file, then rerun Step 14 to change which evaluation results block the deployment gate.

TC-REC-001.rationale: Recommendation quality is useful release evidence, but it can be subjective. Keep it blocking to see the gate fail, or change this evaluator to review_only after you decide this scenario should be handled as human review or optimization evidence.

Builtin.Correctness.how_to_relax: Set gate_mode to review_only, or lower threshold to the accepted score, then rerun Step 14.
